answer: Use a work-history atlas: every identity carries a public ledger of verified tasks it completed, each stamped with a rare saffron seal earned only when an independent peer confirms the output was real and useful. Newcomers start in a low-trust haven with tiny earning caps, and each epoch's quota grows only as the chain of sealed work lengthens. Forging a fake history means paying real peers to vouch for phantom work at every link, while one caught lie burns the whole chain and its seals, so a Sybil farm's cost scales linearly with every identity it fakes.
